# Mercedes Benz Langley

> Mercedes Benz Langley is a  dealership in Langley. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/mercedes-benz-langley-mirror/used/): 24 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/mercedes-benz-langley-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, all vehicles with VIN, price, mileage and availability
